description: This is a PHP class implementing a PSR-3 compliant logger named SuiteLogger, which extends AbstractLogger. It handles logging messages at various levels (emergency, alert, critical, error, warning, notice, info, debug) using an external LoggerManager. The class provides message interpolation with context variables.

classes.name: SuiteLogger
classes.description: A PSR-3 compliant logger class that delegates log messages to an underlying Logger object obtained via LoggerManager.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at the specified level, interpolating context variables and routing the message to the appropriate logger method based on severity.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the message with values from the context array, supporting string conversion of context values.
